flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati and clear any saved data so the app starts empty.
Add people Ana and Ben.
Add a bill named Rent, amount 900.00, paid by Ana, split equally between Ana and Ben.
Add a bill named Electricity, amount 300.00, paid by Ben, split equally between Ana and Ben.
Open Settle up.
Count the payments listed on Settle up.
Assert Settle up shows exactly two payments.
Store the number of payments listed on Settle up, as a word as 'payment_count'.

summary:
The test expectation is wrong for the entered amounts. Ana is owed 450.00 from Rent, while Ana owes Ben 150.00 from Electricity, leaving one net payment of 300.00 from Ben to Ana.
Update the expected payment count to one and store “one” as payment_count. If the intended behavior is to show a separate payment per bill, revise the product requirement and settlement design before testing it.
one_liner: The check expected two payments, but these two shared bills reduce to one net settlement payment.
